props.name: controller
props.description: The controller managing this component's state and behaviour. Bind to it to access the component's imperative API.

props.name: onfirstcreate
props.description: A callback that fires when the component's controller is first created.

props.name: class
props.description: The class names to apply to the adder's button element. Either a class value, or a function deriving one from the adder's state.

props.name: children
props.description: The child content of the adder, containing the contents of the adder button.

props.name: addWidget
props.description: When the user interacts with the adder, this function allows you to specify the configuration of the widget that is created and grabbed. Return null to cancel the add.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: The DOM element bound to this adder.

AdderWidgetConfiguration.name: widget
AdderWidgetConfiguration.description: The configuration of the widget that is created and grabbed.

AdderWidgetConfiguration.name: widthPx
AdderWidgetConfiguration.description: The initial width of the grabbed widget in pixels.

AdderWidgetConfiguration.name: heightPx
AdderWidgetConfiguration.description: The initial height of the grabbed widget in pixels.
